newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Atlas Copco unit to close Brazil plant.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Copco unit to close Brazil plant.

text.p: Swedish industrial engineering group Atlas Copco AB said on Thursday its unit Uniroc AB has decided to phase out its production unit in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
The unit, that makes rock drilling tools, will be relocated to existing units in Sweden and Johannesburg, South Africa.
"By relocating the production, Uniroc will get more rational manufacturing and substantial decrease of delivery times," the company said in a statement.
It said the aim was to phase out the Brazilian production unit which employs 84 staff by the end of the year.
Uniroc is a division within Atlas Copco's construction and mining technique business area with its head office in Fagersta, Sweden.
